convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for 'Slow-Stoch' custom indicator and depends on external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position via BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose permissions are enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: positive values = share of deposit in deal, negative values = fixed lot size; MMMode selects between LOT, RISK, or other MarginMode enumeration methods

custom_logic_notes: Three entry modes selected by AlgMode enum: (1) 'breakdown' - Stochastic crosses 50 level, (2) 'twist' - Stochastic direction change (3-bar comparison: [0] vs [1] vs [2]), (3) 'cloudtwist' - Signal cloud color change (buffer 0 vs buffer 1 crossover). Signal is evaluated on bar specified by SignalBar input (default=1, meaning previous completed bar). When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated on every tick. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs gate each direction's entry and exit independently. GlobalVariableDel_ called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: Three distinct signal modes must be implemented. The custom 'Slow-Stoch' indicator is loaded via iCustom and requires the SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library - its JJMA smoothing implementation must be ported or a Python equivalent found. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions which likely handle position existence checks, order sending, and error recovery - these must be reimplemented. The MM (money management) parameter has dual meaning: positive=deposit fraction, negative=fixed lot. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are used for trade identification via GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup. The SignalBar parameter controls lookback depth (1=previous bar for confirmed signals, 0=re-evaluate every tick). SL/TP are in points not pips - need broker digit awareness.
